scope: Read-only readiness/resource preflight, harness path-selection fixtures and framebench build; no new Kafka workload executed by this agent

harness.default_runtime: source worktree root, preserving previous default behavior
harness.owned_child_termination: SIGTERM, wait 15 seconds, then SIGKILL if needed and wait 5 seconds
harness.telemetry: Selected source/runtime paths, binary SHA256, metadata-only aggregate physical/logical inventory, process CPU/RSS and free disk; private ledgers are not copied

fixture_tests.method: Temporary owned fixture directories and a mocked child; source/runtime paths include spaces; repeated labels must preserve existing reports

initial_memory_observation.interpretation: Memory pressure was present; this is an initial snapshot, not an assertion about conditions during a later workload

resource_snapshots.note: Free space changed during preflight. This agent deleted no retained data and stopped no services; repeat resource checks immediately before sequential loads

planned_bounded_runs.decision: Reassess after the file workload and baseline, using actual remaining disk and memory pressure

acceptance: All workloads, audits and resource-intensive checks run sequentially after the root agent declares UI/tests/build freeze
Each completed profile has a separate new-process -audit-only reader using its own report label
Require no report errors, reconciliation.correct=true and zero missing ACK attempts, receipt mismatches or unexpected records
Report generator skips, busy refusals, unknown outcomes and confirmed attempts separately from the offered 102-million-attempt plan
limitations: No new minute workload or broker crash was executed in this preflight
A direct Go-to-Kafka profile does not measure public HTTP, TLS or QR/browser traffic
A separate reader does not simulate power loss or independent availability zones
Existing Kafka retained bytes are much smaller than in prior experiments; prior reports and client ledgers alone do not prove the old raw Kafka prefix still exists after retention
The profile watcher samples disk once per second and is not a filesystem quota
No polling IDs, voter tokens, private AES seed, connection credentials or private ledger contents are included in this artifact
